description: This file declares the RendererImpl class, a final implementation of the Renderer interface, responsible for rendering audio and video streams in a media pipeline. It includes method declarations for initialization, playback control, track management, buffering, error handling, and testing helpers. It also defines internal state management and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: RendererImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the Renderer interface, managing media rendering including initialization, playback, track management, buffering, error handling, and testing utilities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with media resources, client, and callback.

methods.name: SetCdm
methods.description: Sets the Content Decryption Module (CDM) context.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets the latency hint for media playback.

methods.name: SetPreservesPitch
methods.description: Configures whether pitch is preserved during playback rate changes.

methods.name: SetWasPlayedWithUserActivation
methods.description: Indicates if playback was initiated with user activation.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified media time.

methods.name: GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media playback time.

methods.name: OnSelectedVideoTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in selected video tracks.

methods.name: OnEnabledAudioTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in enabled audio tracks.

methods.name: EnableClocklessVideoPlaybackForTesting
methods.description: Enables clockless video playback for testing.

methods.name: set_time_source_for_testing
methods.description: Sets a custom time source for testing.

methods.name: set_video_underflow_threshold_for_testing
methods.description: Sets a custom underflow threshold for testing.
